summary:
Architectural plan for HR & Recruiter Readiness Improvements:
- Prominent 'Download Resume' (PDF) buttons in both the Overview Hero and the Top Header Bar that open the hosted resume in a new tab.
- Non-intrusive 'Recruiter Quick Tour' bar at the top with 1-click jumps to Selected Projects, Resume, and Contact.
- Interactive in-app live iframe demo sandbox inside the Project Case Study Modal, with quick toggle between Case Study view and Interactive Live Demo.
- Enhanced OpenGraph & SEO tags in index.html for professional rich share cards on LinkedIn, Twitter, and WhatsApp.
